_comment: Run config for INFERENCE/rescue_abc_batch.sh --songs-json. Same shape as a
generate.py manifest (optional 'loras' alias registry + 'defaults' block + a
'songs' list) plus the three rescue dirs. The keys:
pass1_dir  a generate.py --out-dir to rescue FROM; must hold batch_manifest.json
and prompts/ (per take it supplies the lyrics/style/seed/cap - gate G6).
abc_dir    a sheetsage2_transcribe.py --out-dir; per take the guide is read from
abc_dir/<name>_<seed>/score.abc (the ONE new input of a rescue).
out_dir    where rescue WAVs go; MUST differ from pass1_dir and not sit under it.
loras      adapter alias registry, exactly like generate.py:
"<alias>": { "dir": D }            -> D/akbar_arabic_rock_lora_{ar,nar}.safetensors
"<alias>": { "ar": A, "nar": N }   (explicit pair, relative to this file)
defaults   applied to every selected take unless that take overrides it:
lora     adapter alias into 'loras' (else env QF_AR/QF_NAR)
cot      request cot: melody | full | off (built-in: melody)
adapter  label written to the sidecar (default: the resolved lora alias)
threads  CPU threads handed to the binary (built-in: 8)
limit    render at most N takes; 0 = no cap
songs      SELECTORS, not song specs - a rescue reuses the pass-1 take's own
lyrics/style/seed/cap. A bare <name> rescues every take of that
song; a full <name>_<seed> stem rescues exactly one take. An object
entry {"stem"|"name", ...} may override 'lora' and/or 'cot' for
that take ('note' is free text, ignored). Omit 'songs' to rescue
every track in the pass-1 manifest.
Precedence: per-song field > env (cot/adapter) > 'defaults' > built-in; the
adapter pair is per-song/defaults alias > env QF_AR/QF_NAR; the three dirs:
a CLI flag wins over this file. Drive it, and override one thing:
bash INFERENCE/rescue_abc_batch.sh --songs-json this.json --plan
bash INFERENCE/rescue_abc_batch.sh --songs-json this.json --limit 2

songs.note: arrangement good, pronunciation bad -> rescue this one
per-take override: different adapter + cot for this take only
